scope: Local runner guards and versioned schema transaction; in-memory PGlite and mocked HTTP

checks.name: Source project cannot receive any request
Password reset and arbitrary user updates are blocked
Reviewed explicit Auth identity can be created through mocked transport
Storage overwrite is blocked by HTTP guard
Only an exact planned Storage path with no upsert reaches mocked transport
Structured helper progress reaches journal as a string stage
An object cannot become the journal stage
Both schema migrations and history apply together
Fifteen RLS tables and restricted anonymous/owner permissions verified
Second schema run verifies exact SQL hashes and reuses both versions
Unexpected migration history cannot be silently accepted
Failure in migration two rolls back the entire schema transaction
No first-migration schema or history remains after rollback
